node.statement: F2 DEEP-REGIME EXACTNESS THEOREM (2026-07-10, campaign cycle 103): in the deep regime (q large against 2^n), the dichotomy holds EXACTLY for almost every prime row — zero extras, no tolerance needed. THEOREM: fix n = 2^s, j <= 3. The moment vectors of a subset T of mu_n(F_q) are the reductions mod the prime q-above of FIXED cyclotomic integers M_i(T) in Z[zeta_n]; if T is not a coset-union struct block then some M_i(T) != 0 (Lam-Leung at 2-power n: 0/1 vanishing sums are antipodal-pair unions; applied per power i <= j), and its norm is a nonzero integer of size <= n^{phi(n)}, so T can be j-null for at most phi(n) log_2(n)-ish sporadic primes; union over 2^n subsets gives: the number of primes q = 1 mod n in a dyadic window [Q, 2Q] carrying ANY non-struct j-null subset is O(2^n n log n / log Q) — for Q >= 2^{(1+eps)n}, ALMOST EVERY row is EXACT. EMPIRICAL (stronger than the statement): at n = 8, j = 2, ALL 1247 primes q = 1 mod 8 in [257, 50000) have extras = 0 — 1247/1247 exact; this also EXPLAINS the (113,16,j=3) zero-extras autopsy row (q^3 = 1.4M >> 2^16, deep regime). HONEST REGIME CAVEAT (prominent): official rows sit in the OPPOSITE corner (q ~ 2^31 << 2^n, n ~ 2^40) — this theorem closes the sparse-prime corner of the phase diagram and is NOT on the critical path; its value is (a) the first unconditional EXACT-dichotomy regime, (b) the mechanism (cyclotomic rigidity: extras exist mod q only where q divides fixed nonzero cyclotomic norms) — the cleanest available explanation of WHY extras are scarce everywhere measured, and (c) a sharpened falsifier context: deep-regime rows with extras would contradict a THEOREM, not a conjecture. WRITE-UP FLAG DISCHARGED (cycle 114): the per-power Lam-Leung step is proved in full in F2_DEEP_REGIME_LAMLEUNG_NOTE.md (node notes) — a two-descent induction (Lam-Leung at n then at n/2 gives: M_1 = M_2 = 0 iff T is a mu_4-coset union) plus the direct computation that M_3 vanishes automatically on mu_4-coset unions (3 coprime to 4), which ALSO explains the banked identity struct(j=2) = struct(j=3) = 2^{n/4}. The proof chain is complete at full rigor for j <= 3. Verifier: inline in campaign log #115 (local, exhaustive at n=8). Twenty-ninth satellite. PHASE TRANSITION OBSERVED (cycle 119, digest F2_PHASE_TRANSITION_PASS): meet-in-the-middle (O(2^16) per prime) made the exact n=32, j=3 census measurable across the full phase diagram — extras(q) scanned at 78 primes q = 1 mod 32 spanning 97..300000: extras != 0 at 5/8 shallow primes (q <~ 1000, flat-dominated regime), then extras = 0 at ALL 70 primes from q ~ 1000 onward (mid 15/15, boundary 20/20, deep 20/20, very-deep 15/15 exact). The transition is SHARPER than the theorem requires — exactness begins near occupancy 2^n/q^j ~ 4, an order of magnitude before the guaranteed corner q^j ~ 2^n n^2, and not a single sporadic prime appeared in the sample. The dichotomy is EXACT at every measured prime above the trivially-shallow band at this row shape. Verifier: critical/nodes/u2c_giant_tnull_dichotomy/notes/f2_phase_transition_modal.py.
